install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Cloudflare One Client (formerly WARP) — https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/
# Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/team-and-resources/devices/cloudflare-one-client/download/
set -euo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"

echo "==> Installing Cloudflare One Client (cloudflare-warp)"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -y || true
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release apt-transport-https

  curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/pubkey.gpg \
    | gpg --yes --dearmor --output /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-warp-archive-keyring.gpg

  CODENAME="$(lsb_release -cs 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -z "$CODENAME" ] && [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    . /etc/os-release
    CODENAME="${VERSION_CODENAME:-}"
  fi
  if [ -z "$CODENAME" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: could not detect apt codename (lsb_release -cs)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-warp-archive-keyring.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/ ${CODENAME} main" \
    > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflare-client.list

  apt-get update -y
  apt-get install -y cloudflare-warp

elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PKG=dnf
  command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 || PKG=yum

  # RHEL 9+/Alma/Rocky often need EPEL for UI/webview deps
  if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1091
    . /etc/os-release
    case "${ID:-}:${VERSION_ID:-}" in
      rhel:*|centos:*|almalinux:*|rocky:*)
        $PKG install -y epel-release || true
        ;;
    esac
  fi

  rpm --import https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/pubkey.gpg || true
  curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/cloudflare-warp-ascii.repo \
    | tee /etc/yum.repos.d/cloudflare-warp.repo >/dev/null

  $PKG clean all || true
  $PKG install -y cloudflare-warp

elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Cloudflare does not ship an official pacman package." >&2
  echo "Use an AUR helper for cloudflare-warp-bin, or install on Ubuntu/Debian/Fedora/RHEL." >&2
  exit 1
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Cloudflare One Client is not available via Alpine apk from pkg.cloudflareclient.com." >&2
  exit 1
else
  echo "unsupported package manager" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl enable --now warp-svc.service 2>/dev/null \
    || systemctl start warp-svc.service 2>/dev/null \
    || true
fi

command -v warp-cli >/dev/null
echo "==> Installed: $(warp-cli --version 2>/dev/null || echo cloudflare-warp)"
uninstall_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "==> Removing Cloudflare One Client"
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl stop warp-svc.service 2>/dev/null || true
  systemctl disable warp-svc.service 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get remove -y cloudflare-warp || true
  apt-get autoremove -y || true
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflare-client.list
  rm -f /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-warp-archive-keyring.gpg
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf remove -y cloudflare-warp || true
  rm -f /etc/yum.repos.d/cloudflare-warp.repo
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yum remove -y cloudflare-warp || true
  rm -f /etc/yum.repos.d/cloudflare-warp.repo
fi
echo "==> Cloudflare One Client removed"
upgrade_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -y
  apt-get install -y --only-upgrade cloudflare-warp
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf upgrade -y cloudflare-warp
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yum update -y cloudflare-warp
fi
custom_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Post-install: accept TOS when possible and print CLI connect help
set -euo pipefail

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl enable --now warp-svc.service 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Non-interactive TOS accept (safe if already accepted)
if command -v warp-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  warp-cli --accept-tos registration show >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

install -d -m 755 /etc/profile.d
cat > /etc/profile.d/cloudflare-one-client-cli.sh <<'EOF'
# Cloudflare One Client CLI cheat-sheet
# Consumer WARP:
#   warp-cli registration new
#   warp-cli connect
# Zero Trust org:
#   warp-cli registration new <team-name>
#   warp-cli connect
# Status / disconnect:
#   warp-cli status
#   warp-cli disconnect
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/cloudflare-one-client-cli.sh

cat <<'EOF'

==> Cloudflare One Client is installed. Connect with warp-cli:

  # Consumer (personal WARP)
  warp-cli registration new
  warp-cli connect

  # Zero Trust organization
  warp-cli registration new <your-team-name>
  # complete browser login, then:
  warp-cli registration show
  warp-cli connect

  # Headless / copy token from success page
  warp-cli --accept-tos registration token \
    "com.cloudflare.warp://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/auth?token=<TOKEN>"
  warp-cli connect

  # Verify
  warp-cli status
  curl -s https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace | grep warp=

Docs:
  https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/team-and-resources/devices/cloudflare-one-client/download/
  https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/team-and-resources/devices/cloudflare-one-client/deployment/manual-deployment/
  https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/
EOF
